newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ says rights trade to start Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ says rights trade to start Oct 14.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Friday that trading in its 3/11 rights issue would commence on October 14.
The issue of up to 121 million shares at NZ$2 per share is to help pay for Air New Zealand's purchase of half of Ansett Holdings.
People applying for new "A" shares, available to New Zealand residents only, will be able to apply to be issued with new "B" shares, which are able to be owned by foreign investors.
The new shares will be quoted on November 13 and the shares will be allotted on November 22.
